grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or basic cupboard staple, such as lentils, spices, fresh vegetables and natural yoghurt.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board and one large pan, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: 300g red lentils in 1 litre of water for 25 minutes in total gives a soft dal for four, and the thick cucumber chunks hold up for 10 minutes.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is fair for chopping an onion, garlic, chilli and tomatoes and peeling and seeding two cucumbers, and the steps add up to the 30 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, and nothing beyond water is added.

seasonal_feel.reason: Two cucumbers make it the main vegetable of a light August dal, so the hero is the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lentils, vegetables and yoghurt make a filling, wholesome family dinner.
